name: create_express_reviews_resource
description: Adds a reviews resource across a new repository, router, and app mount
prompts: This Express app (src/app.js mounts src/routes/books.js, backed by src/repository/bookRepository.js) serves a books resource. Add a NEW reviews resource spanning every layer: (1) create src/repository/reviewRepository.js exporting a ReviewRepository class with add(bookId, rating, text)->review and listForBook(bookId)->array, using its own auto-incrementing integer ids from 1; each review is {id, bookId, rating, text}; (2) create src/routes/reviews.js: an express.Router with POST / (body {bookId, rating, text}, responds 201 with the created review) and GET /?bookId=N (responds 200 with the reviews for that book, in insertion order); (3) mount it in src/app.js at the path /reviews. Do not break the books routes.
